ex.en: New laws were introduced to safeguard the personal data of ordinary users.
ex.zh: 新法律出台，以保护普通用户的个人数据。

words.note: safe 加 guard 即安全守卫，多接 rights、data 等抽象宾语。

ex.en: She was a diligent student who reviewed her notes every evening after class.
ex.zh: 她是个勤奋的学生，每天课后都会复习笔记。

words.note: diligent 指长期认真刻苦，近义 hard-working，反义 lazy。

ex.en: This laboratory uses sophisticated equipment to analyse tiny samples of rock.
ex.zh: 这个实验室用精密设备分析微小的岩石样本。

words.note: 既指设备精密复杂，也指人老练，如 a sophisticated audience。

ex.en: The small town offers little entertainment for young people on weekday evenings.
ex.zh: 这个小镇在工作日的晚上没多少给年轻人的娱乐。

words.note: 可指抽象的娱乐，也可指具体文娱节目；动词是 entertain。

ex.en: Her family has resided in this coastal village for more than a century.
ex.zh: 她的家族在这个海边村庄居住了一个多世纪。

words.note: reside 比 live 正式；reside in 还可表示性质、权力存在于某处。

ex.en: The sudden drop in sales is indicative of a wider problem in the market.
ex.zh: 销售额骤降表明市场存在更大范围的问题。

words.note: 固定搭配 be indicative of sth，多用于书面语。

ex.en: The nurses on the hospital ward checked every patient twice during the night.
ex.zh: 病房里的护士夜里查了每位病人两次。

words.note: ward 作病房讲最常见；ward off 意为避开、防止。

ex.en: Many students dread speaking in public more than taking written exams.
ex.zh: 许多学生害怕当众讲话甚于笔试。

words.note: dread 后多接动名词，不接 to do；形容词 dreadful 表示可怕的。

ex.en: The company's accounts came under close scrutiny after the scandal broke.
ex.zh: 丑闻曝光后，该公司的账目受到严密审查。

words.note: 多与 come under 连用，表示受到严密审查；动词 scrutinize。

ex.en: The dog chased the ball across the field and brought it back.
ex.zh: 狗在草地上追着球跑，又把球叼了回来。

words.note: chase 后可直接接宾语，也可用 chase after；pursue 更正式。

ex.en: He broke his arm in a traffic accident on his way to work.
ex.zh: 他在上班路上的一场交通事故中摔断了胳膊。

words.note: by accident 意为偶然，不是交通事故；反义表达是 on purpose。

ex.en: The new manager was promoted to head of department after only two years.
ex.zh: 这位新经理仅两年后就被提升为部门主管。

words.note: promote 表晋升时常用 be promoted to；名词 promotion。

ex.en: Regular exercise soon became part of his daily routine.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼很快成了他日常安排的一部分。

words.note: routine 作形容词表例行的，作名词表惯例、固定程序。

ex.en: The old man survived a heart attack last winter thanks to quick treatment.
ex.zh: 多亏抢救及时，这位老人去年冬天心脏病发作后活了下来。

words.note: attack 也指疾病突然发作，如 a heart attack。

ex.en: The couple decided to get a divorce after twenty years of marriage.
ex.zh: 这对夫妻结婚二十年后决定离婚。

words.note: divorce 可作名词也可作动词；be divorced from 还能喻指脱离。

ex.en: The government imposed high tariffs on imported steel to protect local factories.
ex.zh: 政府对进口钢材征收高关税以保护本地工厂。

words.note: tariff 多指关税，也可指价目表，如 the hotel tariff。

ex.en: Please attach your CV to the email before you send the application.
ex.zh: 发送申请前，请把简历附在邮件里。

words.note: attach importance to 是六级高频搭配，名词 attachment。

ex.en: The witness gave a graphic account of the accident that shocked the court.
ex.zh: 目击者对事故作了生动的描述，令法庭震惊。

words.note: graphic 由图画引申为生动逼真的，如 graphic description。

ex.en: The jury convicted him of fraud and he was sentenced to five years.
ex.zh: 陪审团判他犯有诈骗罪，他被判处五年徒刑。

words.note: 动词重音在第二音节；名词囚犯重音在第一音节。

ex.en: Regular review improves memory retention far more than reading alone.
ex.zh: 定期复习对记忆保持的作用远大于只阅读。

words.note: retention 来自 retain；常见搭配 memory retention。

ex.en: The creation of new jobs is the government's top priority this year.
ex.zh: 创造新的就业岗位是政府今年的首要任务。

words.note: creation 指创造或创作的作品；动词 create，形容词 creative。

ex.en: Parliament passed new legislation to limit the use of plastic bags.
ex.zh: 议会通过了限制使用塑料袋的新法规。

words.note: legislation 为不可数名词，说 a piece of legislation。

ex.en: The driver dodged the falling branch and stopped the car just in time.
ex.zh: 司机躲开掉落的树枝，及时刹住了车。

words.note: dodge 指迅速侧身躲开，也指用托辞逃避，如 dodge taxes。

ex.en: Trust is a key ingredient in any long and successful partnership.
ex.zh: 信任是任何长久成功的合作关系中的关键要素。

words.note: ingredient 既指食物原料，也喻指成功要素，常与 key 连用。

ex.en: The country has run a trade surplus for six years in a row.
ex.zh: 该国已连续六年保持贸易顺差。

words.note: surplus 与 deficit 相对；trade surplus 即贸易顺差。

ex.en: The firm consolidated its position in Asia by opening three new offices.
ex.zh: 该公司通过开设三家新办事处巩固了在亚洲的地位。

words.note: con 表共同、solid 表牢固，合起来即巩固；也可指企业合并。

ex.en: She kept up a correspondence with her old teacher for over thirty years.
ex.zh: 她与以前的老师保持通信三十多年。

words.note: correspondence 指书信往来，不可数；动词 correspond。

ex.en: Fear of failure can inhibit students from trying new approaches to learning.
ex.zh: 害怕失败会阻碍学生尝试新的学习方法。

words.note: in 表否定、hibit 表拿住，合起来即抑制；搭配 inhibit from。

ex.en: A short walk after lunch refreshed me and I worked better all afternoon.
ex.zh: 午饭后短暂散步让我精神一振，整个下午效率更高。

words.note: refresh 指恢复精力；refresh one's memory 意为唤醒记忆。

ex.en: They have been intimate friends since they shared a flat at university.
ex.zh: 自大学合租以来，他们一直是亲密的朋友。

words.note: intimate 作形容词重音在第一音节；作动词暗示时读 /ˈɪntɪmeɪt/。
